newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 19.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* Focus on volatile ringgit and interbank rates, which rose sharply last week
* Sharp improvements in inflation and a trade surplus expected to aid market.
* Possibility of gains tempered by the 139-point decline in Dow Jones Industrial Average.
* Brokers say they see market stable, but slightly weaker.
* Petronas Gas results expected, profit seen around forecast levels.
* Bank stocks expected to remain in focus on rumours of exposures and mergers
* MBf Capital and Suria Capital under attention on persistent rumours of merger between the two.
* Cash calls from broking houses to clients may put some pressure on liquidity
